primary_title: Identification of key phosphorylation sites in PTH1R that determine arrestin3 binding and fine-tune receptor signaling
decision_basis: The primary FRET/BRET/FRAP assays support the bounded PTH1R 503-504 cluster-level site-set to ARRB2 recruitment and high-affinity interaction edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human PTH1R 503-504 cluster-2, PTH(1-34) and heterologous-cell assay context; the article alternates Ser503/Thr504 and Thr503/Ser504 labels, so residue identity is not resolved; mutation reduces but does not abolish recruitment, with no universal PTH1R, SCI or terminal-TF expansion.
